wins.text: Full year 2025 worldwide sales of $94.2 billion, up 5.3% operationally despite ~620 bps STELARA headwind; double-digit growth ex-STELARA
DARZALEX full year sales exceeded $14 billion, growing 22% YoY; Q4 growth of 24.1% with 6.5 points of share gain across all lines of therapy
TREMFYA Q4 operational sales growth of 75% in the U.S. and 65% worldwide; full year sales exceeded $5 billion for the first time, with management confident in $10 billion peak year sales potential
Adjusted diluted EPS of $2.46 in Q4, up 20.6% YoY; full year adjusted EPS of $10.79, up 8.1% YoY, exceeding beginning-of-year expectations on both top and bottom line
Free cash flow of $19.7 billion in 2025; 2026 FCF guided to approximately $21 billion; enterprise adjusted pretax operating margin expanded from 24.1% to 28.7% in Q4

risks.text: Full year MedTech tariff impact of approximately $500 million in 2026, significantly above 2025 levels, pressuring cost of goods sold and margins
STELARA biosimilar erosion continues to accelerate following HUMIRA curve; additional generic headwinds from SIMPONI and OPSUMIT beginning in 2026

Talc MDL Daubert ruling: special master partially failed to apply Rule 702 gatekeeping; litigation remains unresolved with ongoing trial and appeal risk; Q4 litigation costs of $0.9 billion related to Auris shareholder resolution
Volume-based procurement (VBP) in China creating headwinds across Surgery and Orthopaedics portfolios, with additional VBP rounds anticipated in 2026
Competitive pressures in electrophysiology PFA market and in energy/endocutters within Surgery; EP business growing below market in 2025

guidance_items.detail: 2026 operational sales growth guided 5.7%-6.7%, midpoint $100 billion (6.2%); reported sales midpoint $100.5 billion (6.7%), above prior trajectory
2026 adjusted operational EPS range $11.28-$11.48 (5.5% growth at midpoint); reported adjusted EPS midpoint $11.53 including $0.15 FX tailwind
2026 adjusted pretax operating margin guided to improve by at least 50 basis points despite $500M tariff headwind and heavier front-loaded investment
Free cash flow guided to approximately $21 billion in 2026, up from $19.7 billion in 2025

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Talc MDL Daubert ruling implications, reserve adequacy, and litigation resolution strategy
ACA subsidy expiration and potential policy changes impact on MedTech procedure volumes
Milvexian competitive positioning vs. Bayer Factor XI inhibitor and path to commercialization
